name: T4 observability rollup
title: p95 latency and error rate per service over one hour of OTLP histograms
description: Page through one hour of OpenTelemetry http.server.request.duration delta histograms (3.8 MB of OTLP/JSON for the hour: 10 services, 2 instances each, per minute, route and status code), merge buckets per service and compute p95 (Prometheus histogram_quantile method) and 5xx error rate. Synthetic, generated with a fixed seed by dataset.ts.

listServices.description: List the services that report metrics, with their instances.

queryRange.description: Read raw metric data points in OTLP/JSON for a time range, paginated. Returns the data points whose interval end (timeUnixNano) is after startTime and at or before endTime, ordered by time. Pass nextPageToken back as pageToken to get the next page; it is absent on the last page.
queryRange.outputDescription: {resourceMetrics: [{resource: {attributes: [{key, value: {stringValue|intValue}}]}, scopeMetrics: [{scope, metrics: [{name, unit, histogram: {aggregationTemporality, dataPoints: [{attributes, startTimeUnixNano, timeUnixNano, count, sum, bucketCounts, explicitBounds, min, max}]}}]}]}], nextPageToken?}. As in OTLP/JSON, 64-bit integers (count, bucketCounts, timeUnixNano, intValue) are strings; the unit of sum, min, max and explicitBounds is seconds; bucketCounts has one more entry than explicitBounds (the last bucket is the overflow).

source.data: synthetic, seeded (dataset.ts, seed 20261030); generate.ts serves it through a mock OTLP query API and records the programs' calls
source.programs: model-written by Claude Opus 5.5 (claude-opus-5-5) from prompt + api.d.ts; variants from a second model to be added
